name: WARNING: Applebee's Spinach & Artichoke Dip with Tortilla Chips
whyItWorks: Creamy dip made with Parmesan cheese, cream cheese, garlic puree, and chopped spinach/artichoke, served with crisp fried corn tortilla chips and salsa. High dairy fat + allium fructans + abrasive corn chips causes rapid digestive distress.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip creamy restaurant dips. Choose plain warm bread without garlic butter if tolerated.
